scope: The 21 destinations with zero selections before this pass.
method: Manual title, author, form, date and country-connection review. Dates describe the linked edition. Original-language titles are retained unless a sourced English catalogue title is used. No claim of English translation availability. Short notes are original paraphrases of the linked sources. Country affiliations can include diaspora and sustained residence; these are explicitly distinguished from ancestry. Unresolved means no eligible match verified in this pass, not a claim that no novels exist. ISBN alone is not enough to accept an API result.
